output.summary: FY2026 revenue growth tracks the commodity rally: volume was flat, handling revenue flat, and the auditor attributes the margin gain to inventory appreciation. The cooperative ranks mid-to-low among peers, none of which adopted a program, so credit to Operational Excellence is unsupported. The maintenance backlog tripled, including safety and dust items at Harlan Junction, so cost-per-bushel gains likely reflect deferral. The Superintendent dependence is confounded with dryer vintage and site. Expansion viability is unestablished. Fix the safety hazards, begin succession work, and defer the vote until the case is rebuilt on normalized prices. Holding maintenance flat is harmful.
